QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_33

question.text: The engagement documentation for an SIA should be assembled in a final engagement file:

answer.text: Immediately on the date of the AIR signing, with no further period
On a timely basis, ordinarily not more than 60 days after the date of the social impact assessment report
At the SIA's discretion, no prescribed timeline

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.11.1 Documentation states: 'He/she should complete the administrative process of assembling the final engagement file on a timely basis, usually not more than 60 days after the date of the social impact assessment report.' After assembly, the SIA cannot delete/discard engagement documentation before the retention period ends. The Trap: A (immediate) is unrealistic; C (180 days) is too long; D (no timeline) is contrary to the framework. Cross-Exam Context: SA 230 in financial audit has the same 60-day file-assembly rule; XXIII mirrors it for SIA. Assessor's Pro-Tip: Calendar a 45-day reminder after each AIR sign-off to assemble and lock the engagement file — a 60-day external deadline gives you a 15-day buffer for unforeseen issues.
